title: Deep Hedging
description: A research implementation of neural hedging policies that account for transaction costs and discrete trading. Compares learned strategies with classical delta hedging and evaluates downside risk using simulated profit-and-loss distributions.

title: GPU Inference Benchmark
description: A reproducible harness for studying language-model inference under concurrent load. Measures latency percentiles and throughput with synthetic traffic, a simulated backend, and an optional Hugging Face backend. Quantization and cache-reuse effects are simulated in the dummy backend.

title: Community Insights Dashboard
description: An interactive dashboard for exploring NGO programs in child welfare and education. Brings together beneficiaries, attendance, donations, and outcomes with regional comparisons and optional AI-generated insights.

title: ML Crop Recommendation
description: A web application that recommends crops from soil nutrients, pH, temperature, humidity, and rainfall. Explores several classifiers, with Random Forest selected for the app. Related work was co-authored for the Indian Journal of Natural Sciences in 2023.

title: Cancer Gene Classification
description: A machine learning project using the Sanger Cancer Gene Census dataset to classify oncogenes and tumor suppressor genes, distinguish mutation types, and explore chromosomal patterns. Compares Random Forest, XGBoost, and Logistic Regression.

title: MindConnect
description: A Java application connecting mental-health care workflows across patients, doctors, insurance providers, pharmacies, and administrators. Organizes appointments, prescriptions, insurance handling, and government welfare schemes in a shared ecosystem.
credit: With Raksha Krishna Moorthy and Tanvi Reddy Bollavaram.

title: Sports Injury Management System
description: A centralized database project for athlete injuries, treatment progress, and return-to-play clearances. Uses database views, triggers, stored procedures, and user-defined functions, with Power BI reports for injury and recovery analysis.
credit: With Abisha Vadukoot, Ayush Fulsundar, and Ranveer Rajput.

title: Number Plate Recognition
description: A desktop application that locates number plates in uploaded vehicle images and extracts text with OCR. Combines grayscale processing, Sobel edges, thresholding, and contour filtering with a Tkinter image-upload interface.

title: Autonomous Drone Delivery
description: An undergraduate capstone combining a delivery-ordering application with simulated autonomous drone navigation. Uses Flutter and Dart for the user interface and ArduPilot with Mission Planner for flight simulation. Physical drone integration is future work.
credit: With Maria Nikitha and Bhuvana Ravikumar, guided by Prof. R. Indra.
